AssetMarkerTarget.description: ``time_us`` is source time of the asset.
AssetMarkerTarget.title: AssetMarkerTarget

Batch.description: Several commands applied in order as one; its inverse undoes them in reverse.
Batch.title: Batch

BeatAnchor.description: Offset from the anchored beat's visible start on the main line.
BeatAnchor.title: BeatAnchor

BladeItem.description:
Split an item at source time ``at_us``.

The left part keeps the id, the right part gets ``new_item_id``; a transition on the
cut after the original item moves to the right part, and item markers at or after
the split move with it. Fade-out goes to the right part, fade-in stays on the left.
BladeItem.title: BladeItem

ClipItem.description: A main-line (V1 + A1) item: a source range of one asset.
ClipItem.title: ClipItem

ClipPadding.description: Padding added around a take's word range when it becomes a cut item.
ClipPadding.title: ClipPadding

EditorTransition.description:
Transition at the cut between two adjacent video clips on one lane.

It is dormant (ignored) while the clips are missing or not adjacent, so edits
never fail because of a transition; see editor.transitions.
EditorTransition.title: EditorTransition

HeldRange.description: Assembly time retained by a standard audio trim, without a fake media clip.
HeldRange.title: HeldRange

ItemMarkerTarget.description: ``time_us`` is source time of the item's asset.
ItemMarkerTarget.title: ItemMarkerTarget

MoveBeat.description: Reorder: move a beat to ``to_index`` (story order). Transitions may go dormant.
MoveBeat.title: MoveBeat

MoveTake.description: Move a take to another beat (it arrives as an alternate). Locks both beats.
MoveTake.title: MoveTake

ProjectAnchor.description: Absolute timeline time (does not follow ripple edits).
ProjectAnchor.title: ProjectAnchor

PromoteTake.description:
Make a take the selected one and rebuild the beat's cut from it.

The new cut item gets ``new_item_id``, the take range plus the project clip padding
(trims reset), and the audio settings of the previous first cut item. Transitions on
the beat's outer edges are re-attached to the new item; transitions inside the old
cut are left dormant.
PromoteTake.title: PromoteTake

PutBeat.description: Replace an existing beat by id with the given content (restore primitive).
PutBeat.title: PutBeat

PutTransition.description: Restore primitive: upsert a transition by id without adjacency checks.
PutTransition.title: PutTransition

Rational.description: A positive rational rate, e.g. ``Rational(num=30000, den=1001)`` for 29.97 fps.
Rational.title: Rational

RemoveAsset.description: Remove an asset that nothing references any more.
RemoveAsset.title: RemoveAsset

RemoveBeat.description: Remove a beat (merge/split plumbing). Excluding a beat is ``SetBeatIncluded``.
RemoveBeat.title: RemoveBeat

SetEditor.description: Replace an interactive gesture atomically; None restores legacy edit ownership.
SetEditor.title: SetEditor

SetItemEnabled.description: ``enabled=False`` is ripple delete: the item leaves the main line, gap closed.
SetItemEnabled.title: SetItemEnabled

SetTakeStatus.description: Mark a take alternate or rejected. Selecting a take is ``PromoteTake``.
SetTakeStatus.title: SetTakeStatus

SetTransition.description: Put a transition on an active main-line cut (replaces the one on that cut).
SetTransition.title: SetTransition

SyncGroup.description: Simultaneous recordings of the same moment (multicam / external audio).
SyncGroup.title: SyncGroup

TakeRef.description: A segment proposed or accepted as a take of a beat. Scores/flags are not stored.
TakeRef.title: TakeRef

TranscriptEdit.description: User correction of the transcript words of ``asset_id`` within a source range.
TranscriptEdit.title: TranscriptEdit

Transition.description:
Transition on the main-line cut after ``after_item_id``.

Active only while ``before_item_id`` directly follows ``after_item_id`` on the main
line; dormant otherwise (kept, compiled as a hard cut with a warning).
Transition.title: Transition

UpdateBeat.description: Edit beat metadata. Fields left unset are unchanged; locks unless ``locked`` given.
UpdateBeat.title: UpdateBeat
